The block itself concedes two paragraphs later (via the context remark) that 'the categorical derivation of the integer 2 … is not closed' and that rho_F 'is consumed as an input hypothesis', so the +5.9%% is a one-parameter fit's residual, not a parameter-free prediction — yet the .ts carries a 'no-fitting' tag. The comparison may well be right; 'dramatically' is doing work the epistemics do not support.
